verdict.seen: Frame 1 shows the lawn with soil clods and no hole yet. Frames 2 and 3 show a dug hole in section filled with blue water, next to the house.
The water level falls across the frames and the hole ends up with a dry soil floor. Blue arrows point down into the soil and a LEAKING label is shown.
The dry hole gets a beige concrete floor and walls in frame 2. In frame 3 the shell is full of water, which stays inside it.
The pool water changes from clear blue in frame 1 to green in frames 2 and 3. An ALGAE label is shown.
A small pump box appears in frame 1. In frames 2 and 3 the pump has grown, the sand tank is there and pipes run underground to the pool. The pool water looks bluer.
A yellow glowing outline surrounds the pump and sand tank, which sit on the grass with pipes below. Everything is readable.
The pipes start white with a highlight outline. In frames 2 and 3 they carry blue water dots running between the pool and the filter.
A counter beside the filter goes from 0 to 6 across the frames, and the pipes show flow dots. The strip ends at 6, not 8.
The whole finished pool is in view with the filter, pipes and house. The camera pulls back across the frames and nothing covers the build.
